source_refs.note: Exercise 13.1, Question 4 (book page 248, PDF 253); answer key PDF 310-311.

blocks.prompt: 4 (i) Find from first principle, the derivatives of the following expression w.r.t. their respective independent variables: \((3x - 2)^{-2}\).
blocks.explanation:
Negative power ka matlab hai "ek bata": \((3x - 2)^{-2} = \frac{1}{(3x - 2)^2}\). To asal mein yeh fraction ka sawal hai.
Humein \(f'(x)\) chahiye, first principle se.
Plan: do fractions ko common denominator se ek karenge. Upar \(A^2 - B^2\) ban jayega, jise \((A - B)(A + B)\) mein toda ja sakta hai; \(A - B\) mein se \(\delta x\) nikal aayega. Phir cancel aur limit.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(f(x) = (3x - 2)^{-2} = \frac{1}{(3x - 2)^2}\).
Find karna hai: \(f'(x)\), first principles se.
Tareeqa: definition (first principles / ab-initio, yani bilkul shuru se) se derivative: \(f'(x) = \lim_{\delta x \to 0} \frac{f(x + \delta x) - f(x)}{\delta x}\). Chaar steps yaad rakhein: (I) \(f(x + \delta x)\) likhein; (II) us mein se \(f(x)\) minus karein; (III) \(\delta x\) se divide karein; (IV) \(\delta x \to 0\) ka limit lein. Yeh tareeqa is liye ke Exercise 13.1 mein sawal khud 'by definition' maangta hai, aur power rule waghera abhi Section 13.6 mein aaenge; is liye shortcut nahi, poora limit ka safar dikhana hai.

Step I aur II: ek fraction
\[f(x + \delta x) = \dfrac{1}{(3x + 3\,\delta x - 2)^2}\]
\[f(x + \delta x) - f(x)\]
\[= \dfrac{(3x - 2)^2 - (3x + 3\,\delta x - 2)^2}{(3x + 3\,\delta x - 2)^2\,(3x - 2)^2}\]
Kyun: \(x\) ki jagah \(x + \delta x\) rakha: \(3(x + \delta x) - 2 = 3x + 3\,\delta x - 2\). Dhyan dein, \(3\) ne \(\delta x\) ko bhi multiply kiya. Phir dono fractions ko common denominator par laaye; upar purana minus naya aata hai.

Upar ko factorise karein
\[A = 3x - 2,\ B = 3x + 3\,\delta x - 2\]
\[A - B = -3\,\delta x\]
\[A + B = 6x - 4 + 3\,\delta x\]
\[A^2 - B^2 = -3\,\delta x\,(6x - 4 + 3\,\delta x)\]
Kyun: Upar \(A^2 - B^2\) ki shakal hai. Poora square kholne ke bajaye \((A - B)(A + B)\) use kiya, jo bohat chhota kaam hai. \(A - B\) mein \(3x\) aur \(-2\) cancel ho kar sirf \(-3\,\delta x\) bachta hai: yehi woh \(\delta x\) hai jo humein cancel karna hai.

Step III: \(\delta x\) se divide karein
\[\dfrac{f(x + \delta x) - f(x)}{\delta x}\]
\[= \dfrac{-3\,(6x - 4 + 3\,\delta x)}{(3x + 3\,\delta x - 2)^2\,(3x - 2)^2}\]
Kyun: Upar ka \(\delta x\) divide wale \(\delta x\) se cancel ho gaya. Ab neeche zero banne ka khatra nahi.

Step IV: limit lein
\[f'(x) = \dfrac{-3(6x - 4)}{(3x - 2)^2(3x - 2)^2}\]
\[= \dfrac{-3 \cdot 2(3x - 2)}{(3x - 2)^4}\]
\[= \dfrac{-6}{(3x - 2)^3}\]
Kyun: \(\delta x = 0\) rakha. Upar \(6x - 4 = 2(3x - 2)\) likha taake neeche wale \((3x - 2)^4\) se ek factor cancel ho sake. \(-3 \times 2 = -6\) aur neeche \((3x - 2)^3\) bacha.

Tasdeeq: Section 13.6 ke power rule se (sirf jawab confirm karne ke liye, tareeqa nahi)
\[\dfrac{d}{dx}(3x - 2)^{-2} = -2(3x - 2)^{-3} \cdot 3\]
\[= \dfrac{-6}{(3x - 2)^3} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \((ax + b)^n\) ka derivative \(n(ax + b)^{n-1} \cdot a\) hota hai (yeh baad mein parhenge). Yahan \(n = -2\), \(a = 3\): wohi jawab.

blocks.prompt: 4 (ii) Find from first principle, the derivatives of the following expression w.r.t. their respective independent variables: \((2x + 3)^5\).
blocks.explanation:
Power \(5\) hai, is liye bracket ko seedha multiply karna bohat lamba ho jayega. Yahan binomial theorem kaam aata hai.
Humein \(f'(x)\) chahiye jab \(f(x) = (2x + 3)^5\).
Plan: \(u = 2x + 3\) aur \(k = 2\,\delta x\) rakhenge, kyunke \(2(x + \delta x) + 3 = u + k\). Phir \((u + k)^5\) ko binomial theorem se kholenge; \(u^5\) cancel ho jayega aur baqi har term mein \(\delta x\) hoga.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(f(x) = (2x + 3)^5\).
Find karna hai: \(f'(x)\), first principles se.
Tareeqa: definition (first principles / ab-initio, yani bilkul shuru se) se derivative: \(f'(x) = \lim_{\delta x \to 0} \frac{f(x + \delta x) - f(x)}{\delta x}\). Chaar steps yaad rakhein: (I) \(f(x + \delta x)\) likhein; (II) us mein se \(f(x)\) minus karein; (III) \(\delta x\) se divide karein; (IV) \(\delta x \to 0\) ka limit lein. Yeh tareeqa is liye ke Exercise 13.1 mein sawal khud 'by definition' maangta hai, aur power rule waghera abhi Section 13.6 mein aaenge; is liye shortcut nahi, poora limit ka safar dikhana hai. Binomial theorem: \((u + k)^n = u^n + n u^{n-1}k + \binom{n}{2}u^{n-2}k^2 + \dots + k^n\). Pehli term ke baad har term mein \(k\) kam az kam ek dafa hai, aur \(k\) mein \(\delta x\) hai; isi liye pehli term cancel hone ke baad har term \(\delta x\) se divide ho sakti hai.

Step I: \(f(x + \delta x)\) nikalein
\[f(x + \delta x) = (2x + 2\,\delta x + 3)^5\]
\[= (u + k)^5,\quad u = 2x + 3,\ k = 2\,\delta x\]
Kyun: \(2(x + \delta x) + 3\) ko \((2x + 3) + 2\,\delta x\) likha. Naye naam \(u\) aur \(k\) sirf likhai chhoti karne ke liye hain; \(k\) chhota hai kyunke us mein \(\delta x\) hai.

Step II: kholein aur minus karein
\[(u + k)^5 = u^5 + 5u^4k + 10u^3k^2 + 10u^2k^3 + 5uk^4 + k^5\]
\[f(x + \delta x) - f(x) = 5u^4k + 10u^3k^2 + 10u^2k^3 + 5uk^4 + k^5\]
Kyun: \(n = 5\) ke binomial coefficients \(1, 5, 10, 10, 5, 1\) hain (Pascal triangle ki chhati line). \(u^5\) bilkul \(f(x)\) hai, is liye minus karne se cancel. Baqi har term mein \(k\) hai.

Step III: \(\delta x\) se divide karein
\[k = 2\,\delta x \Rightarrow \dfrac{k}{\delta x} = 2\]
\[\dfrac{f(x + \delta x) - f(x)}{\delta x} = 2\big(5u^4 + 10u^3k + 10u^2k^2 + 5uk^3 + k^4\big)\]
Kyun: Har term se ek \(k\) bahar nikala: \(\frac{k(\dots)}{\delta x} = \frac{k}{\delta x}(\dots) = 2(\dots)\). Bracket ke andar ab sirf pehli term \(5u^4\) mein \(k\) nahi hai.

Step IV: limit lein
\[\delta x \to 0 \Rightarrow k \to 0\]
\[f'(x) = 2 \cdot 5u^4 = 10u^4\]
\[= 10(2x + 3)^4\]
Kyun: \(\delta x \to 0\) to \(k = 2\,\delta x \to 0\), is liye \(k\) wali saari terms zero ho jati hain. Sirf \(2 \times 5u^4 = 10u^4\) bachta hai, aur \(u = 2x + 3\) wapas rakh diya.

Tasdeeq: Section 13.6 ke power rule se (sirf jawab confirm karne ke liye, tareeqa nahi)
\[\dfrac{d}{dx}(2x + 3)^5 = 5(2x + 3)^4 \cdot 2 = 10(2x + 3)^4 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(n(ax + b)^{n-1}\cdot a\) se bhi wohi jawab aur answer key bhi \(10(2x + 3)^4\) deti hai.

blocks.prompt: 4 (iii) Find from first principle, the derivatives of the following expression w.r.t. their respective independent variables: \((ax + b)^7\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh 4(ii) jaisa hi hai, bas numbers ki jagah letters \(a\) aur \(b\) hain. Yeh dono constants hain; sirf \(x\) badalta hai.
Plan: \(u = ax + b\) aur \(k = a\,\delta x\), kyunke \(a(x + \delta x) + b = u + k\). Phir binomial theorem se \((u + k)^7\) kholenge. Saari terms likhne ki zaroorat nahi: pehli do terms aur "baqi terms jin mein \(k^2\) ya zyada hai" kaafi hai.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(f(x) = (ax + b)^7\), \(a\), \(b\) constants.
Find karna hai: \(f'(x)\), first principles se.
Tareeqa: definition (first principles / ab-initio, yani bilkul shuru se) se derivative: \(f'(x) = \lim_{\delta x \to 0} \frac{f(x + \delta x) - f(x)}{\delta x}\). Chaar steps yaad rakhein: (I) \(f(x + \delta x)\) likhein; (II) us mein se \(f(x)\) minus karein; (III) \(\delta x\) se divide karein; (IV) \(\delta x \to 0\) ka limit lein. Yeh tareeqa is liye ke Exercise 13.1 mein sawal khud 'by definition' maangta hai, aur power rule waghera abhi Section 13.6 mein aaenge; is liye shortcut nahi, poora limit ka safar dikhana hai. Binomial theorem: \((u + k)^n = u^n + n u^{n-1}k + \binom{n}{2}u^{n-2}k^2 + \dots + k^n\). Pehli term ke baad har term mein \(k\) kam az kam ek dafa hai, aur \(k\) mein \(\delta x\) hai; isi liye pehli term cancel hone ke baad har term \(\delta x\) se divide ho sakti hai.

Step I: \(f(x + \delta x)\) nikalein
\[f(x + \delta x) = (ax + a\,\delta x + b)^7\]
\[= (u + k)^7,\quad u = ax + b,\ k = a\,\delta x\]
Kyun: \(a\) ne \(x\) aur \(\delta x\) dono ko multiply kiya, is liye chhota hissa \(k = a\,\delta x\) hai, sirf \(\delta x\) nahi. Yahi wajah hai ke jawab mein aakhir mein \(a\) aata hai.

Step II: kholein aur minus karein
\[(u + k)^7 = u^7 + 7u^6k + 21u^5k^2 + \dots + k^7\]
\[f(x + \delta x) - f(x) = 7u^6k + 21u^5k^2 + \dots + k^7\]
Kyun: \(n = 7\) ke liye pehli coefficients \(1, 7, 21, \dots\) hain. \(u^7\) hi \(f(x)\) hai, is liye cancel. Baqi har term mein kam az kam ek \(k\) hai, aur teesri term se aage \(k^2\) ya us se zyada.

Step III: \(\delta x\) se divide karein
\[\dfrac{k}{\delta x} = a\]
\[\dfrac{f(x + \delta x) - f(x)}{\delta x} = a\big(7u^6 + 21u^5k + \dots + k^6\big)\]
Kyun: Har term se ek \(k\) bahar nikala aur \(\frac{k}{\delta x} = \frac{a\,\delta x}{\delta x} = a\). Bracket mein pehli term ke ilawa sab mein abhi bhi \(k\) hai.

Step IV: limit lein
\[\delta x \to 0 \Rightarrow k \to 0\]
\[f'(x) = a \cdot 7u^6 = 7a(ax + b)^6\]
Kyun: \(k \to 0\) hone se \(k\) wali terms khatam; sirf \(7u^6\) bacha, jise \(a\) se multiply kiya. \(u = ax + b\) wapas rakha.

Tasdeeq: Section 13.6 ke power rule se (sirf jawab confirm karne ke liye, tareeqa nahi)
\[\dfrac{d}{dx}(ax + b)^7 = 7(ax + b)^6 \cdot a \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Rule \(n(ax + b)^{n-1}\cdot a\) se bhi wohi jawab, aur answer key \(7a(ax + b)^6\) deti hai.
